The '''Antmuel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Chopani sector/Legends|Chopani sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="Region" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Antmuel VI]] occupied the sixth [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position within the system.<ref name="HR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Antmuel system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed it within grid square M-3.<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
